project_type: Multi-repo: (1) OmniRoute — Next.js/TypeScript LLM gateway (open-sse server + src app) run as `omniroute serve`; (2) esnixi — NixOS flake over SSH providing vLLM + a serialized switcher and Python routing-policy generators; (3) menagerie — VS Code extension (Zoo Code / Roo fork) with a React webview-ui, consuming OmniRoute as an OpenAI-compatible provider.
language: TypeScript (OmniRoute, menagerie), Python 3 (esnixi switcher + routing generators), Nix (esnixi flake)
build_system: OmniRoute: npm + Next.js (node --test for tests/unit, vitest for src/lib and open-sse via vitest.config.ts / vitest.mcp.config.ts). menagerie: pnpm workspaces + turbo + Vitest; run suites from the package dir (webview-ui, src). esnixi: nixos-rebuild build/switch via flake .#esnixi (switch is OPERATOR-only, needs sudo on the host).
test_framework: OmniRoute: vitest (src/lib/memory/__tests__ under vitest.config.ts) + node test runner (tests/unit). menagerie: Vitest per package. esnixi switcher: python3 -m pytest beside vllm-switch.py.

key_patterns: OmniRoute memory injection: injectMemory() in src/lib/memory/injection.ts chooses a strategy by provider; strict-template providers must go through injectSystemFirst (merge into messages[0]) via BUILTIN_PROVIDERS_SYSTEM_MUST_BE_FIRST or OMNIROUTE_STRICT_SYSTEM_PROVIDERS env. Per-request steering lives in open-sse/services/autoCombo/requestControls.ts (X-OmniRoute-Mode/-Budget headers resolved purely, fed to the auto-combo engine without mutating stored config) — the pattern to follow for the new X-OmniRoute-Tier. esnixi routing policy: omniroute-mode.py (WEIGHTS/TIER1_OVERRIDES/CLOUD/MODES + apply with backups+drift checks) and omniroute-routing.py (combo plan + model-capability-override PATCH plan, applied when not --code-only). menagerie OmniRoute client: src/api/providers/omniroute.ts (isOmniRoute flag, tokenized base URL, combo catalog fetch); DEFAULT_HEADERS in src/api/providers/constants.ts.
directory_structure: OmniRoute: src/lib/memory (injection + tests), open-sse/handlers (chatCore + chatCore/*), open-sse/services/autoCombo (per-request controls, mode packs), open-sse/utils (diagnostics), tests/unit (node-test suites by domain), vitest.config.ts (src/lib + open-sse __tests__), home/programs is NOT present here (lives on esnixi). esnixi flake: esnixi/ (vllm.nix, vllm-switch.py, vllm-idle.nix), home/programs/ (omniroute-mode.py, omniroute-routing.py), modules/profiles/ai.nix. menagerie: src/api/providers (omniroute client), src/core/webview (ClineProvider, webviewMessageHandler), webview-ui/src/components (chat, settings), packages/types/src (global-settings, vscode-extension-host).
